visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens indoors where a young man with messy brown hair and glasses, wearing a grey t-shirt, speaks directly into a handheld camera. Behind him is a white wardrobe and a glass display case filled with figurines. (2) Following a quick jump cut, the scene shifts to an outdoor retail shop in a busy urban alley. The man stands in front of a small wooden counter labeled '世時梅酒' (Sensera). A female passerby in a blue shirt and jeans stands briefly in the background. (3) The man introduces the shop owner, another male wearing a black apron with tattoos on his arms, standing behind the counter. The counter is lined with glass bottles of plum wine featuring distinct artistic labels. (4) The camera zooms in on specific bottles of '柚香梅酒' (Yuzu Plum Wine) and '炭焙' (Charcoal Roasted) varieties. The owner pours a light amber liquid from a bottle into a small glass near a wooden tap. (5) The creator takes the small glass and drinks the wine, gesturing with a thumbs-up while smiling. The setting is brightly lit by natural daylight filtering into the open-front shop. (6) The shop owner holds up promotional items: a white canvas bag with yellow and pink patterns and a tiny square LED light box featuring the brand logo. (7) The final phase shows the creator back on the street, holding the bag and the mini light box, waving to the camera as the sun begins to set in the background.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video starts in a bedroom with a white closet and a toy display cabinet. It then moves to an open-front wooden plum wine shop located on a busy pedestrian street with banners, other shops, and parked scooters visible in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-energy speech from a young male narrator, accompanied by an upbeat, mid-tempo electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 drum beat. The vocal is clear with a casual, friendly tone. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX triggers as the acoustic environment shifts to include outdoor city hum and distant crowd chatter. The narrator continues speaking with high arousal as he greets a second male voice. (3) The second male voice (shop owner) speaks with a professional yet warm tone, explaining products. The sound of liquid pouring into a glass (splashing transient) is clearly audible over the music. (4) A female voice briefly exclaims '学到了' (Learned it!) with a rising intonation, followed by a playful 'pop' sound effect. (5) The shop owner details opening promotions; the sound of a plastic/fabric bag rustling occurs as items are handled. (6) The video ends with the narrator’s voice trailing off as the BGM maintains its upbeat tempo until the final cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Travel -> Demonstration -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lifestyle vlog and commercial promotion for a friend's new plum wine specialty shop, '世時梅酒', in Tainan's Guohua Street. It aims to introduce the brand's unique flavors and announce grand opening promotions to drive foot traffic.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator specifically visits the store, interviews the owner, tastes the product, and details opening day promotional gifts and price tiers.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A typical social media influencer-style promotional video characterized by fast-paced editing, bright visuals, and high-energy narration to maintain viewer engagement.
